steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Freehand sketching: quick, expressive, captures ideas rapidly - the primary tool for initial concept generation. Annotations explain function, materials and dimensions.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Rendering: adding tone, texture and colour to sketches - creates realistic appearance, shows material properties, communicates design intent to clients.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: CAD (Computer-Aided Design): 2D (vector for laser cutting), 3D (solid modelling for visualisation, FEA, 3D printing). Precision, easy modification, virtual testing, output for CAM.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Orthographic projection: 2D technical drawings showing front, side and plan views - precise, scaled, used for manufacture. Third-angle projection (UK standard).
